scripts.ml:v2:data: node -e "const c = require('./src/server/ml/training/train-ensemble-v2').loadCleanCandles(); console.log('Clean candles loaded:', c.length);"

scripts.ml:v2:validate: node -e "const c = require('./src/server/ml/training/train-ensemble-v2').loadCleanCandles(); const f = require('./src/server/ml/features/feature-engineering-v2').generateBatchFeaturesV2(c, 20); const { dataset } = require('./src/server/ml/target/target-generator-v2').generateTargetsV2(f); const wf = require('./src/server/ml/validation/walk-forward-v2').runWalkForwardValidation(dataset); console.log('Walk-forward diagnostics:', wf.diagnostics);"
scripts.ml:v2:calibrate: node -e "const a = require('./src/server/ml/artifacts/tcs_ensemble_v2.json'); console.log('Platt calibration parameters:', a.calibration);"
scripts.ml:v2:ensemble: node -e "const a = require('./src/server/ml/artifacts/tcs_ensemble_v2.json'); console.log('Ensemble models & weights:', a.modelsEnsemble.weights);"
scripts.ml:v2:backtest: node -e "const { loadCleanCandles } = require('./src/server/ml/training/train-ensemble-v2'); const { generateBatchFeaturesV2 } = require('./src/server/ml/features/feature-engineering-v2'); const { splitChronologicalData } = require('./src/server/ml/validation/walk-forward-v2'); const BacktestEngineV2 = require('./src/server/ml/backtest-engine-v2'); const modelRunner = require('./src/server/ml/model-runner'); const candles = loadCleanCandles(); const feats = generateBatchFeaturesV2(candles, 20); const { testSet } = splitChronologicalData(feats); const bt = new BacktestEngineV2(); const res = bt.runComparativeBacktest(testSet, modelRunner, modelRunner.ensembleV2); console.log('Backtest comparison completed across', res.totalBars, 'bars. Strategies:', Object.keys(res.comparison));"
scripts.ml:v2:reproduce: node -e "console.log('--- REPRODUCING AURUM ML V2 ENSEMBLE ---'); const { trainAndExportEnsembleV2 } = require('./src/server/ml/training/train-ensemble-v2'); const res = trainAndExportEnsembleV2(); console.log('Reproduced Artifact Hash:', res.artifactHash); const { runTestSuite } = require('./src/server/ml/tests/test_ml_v2'); runTestSuite();"
